title: Home Clinic Changes and Pet Changes on a Wellness Plan
content:
The home clinic of a Tailwise Vet Clinic Wellness Plans plan may be moved to any Tailwise Vet Clinic where the plan allows clinic transfers; services already used stay counted. A plan is never moved to another pet.

| Plan | Home clinic may be changed to another Tailwise Vet Clinic | Plan may be moved to another pet |
|---|---|---|
| Puppy Wellness Plan | Yes | No |
| Kitten Wellness Plan | Yes | No |
| Adult Dog Wellness Plan | Yes | No |
| Adult Cat Wellness Plan | Yes | No |
| Senior Dog Wellness Plan | Yes | No |
| Senior Cat Wellness Plan | Yes | No |

## What a clinic transfer changes

A clinic transfer changes the plan's home clinic and nothing else. The plan, its term and its fees stay as they were, and the services already redeemed in the term stay counted against the plan's counts at the new home clinic.

**Hypothetical illustration.** An Adult Cat Wellness Plan has one of its two wellness exams used at its original home clinic. After the home clinic moves to another Tailwise Vet Clinic, the term still shows one wellness exam used, with one remaining.

## The covered pet

The covered pet does not change. A plan held for one dog cannot be moved to the household's other dog, under any of the six plans.
